title: Ideal-adic order and minimal homogeneous generating families
statement: Let $(V,\mathfrak l)$ be a commutative local ring. Use the associated graded ring $G=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\mathfrak l^n/\mathfrak l^{n+1}$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. Define $\operatorname{ord}_J(h)=\sup\{n\in\mathbf N:h\in J^n\}\in\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\}$ for any ideal $J$ of a commutative ring. An indexed family $(\xi_i)_{i<m}$ minimally generates an ideal $E$ when it generates $E$ and no $\xi_i$ lies in the ideal of the other members. A family in an associated graded ring has degrees $(d_i)$ when $\xi_i$ is in the image of the degree-$d_i$ summand. The empty family is allowed.

source.place: Hironaka, Certain numerical characters of singularities (1970), §2, pp.153–154; §3 and Remark 1, p.155. Online PDF as in the item source.
